rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for promotional advertising and advertisements aimed at potential customers.

example.english: The advertising keeps popping up online and is really annoying.
example.traditional: 呢啲廣告成日喺網上彈出嚟，真係好煩。
example.jyutping: ni1 di1 gwong2 gou3 seng4 jat6 hai2 mong5 soeng6 taan4 ceot1 lei4 zan1 hai6 hou2 faan4

rows.note: Use this when referring specifically to advertising as an industry or business sector.

example.english: After graduating, they went into the advertising industry.
example.traditional: 佢畢業之後入咗廣告業做。
example.jyutping: keoi5 bat1 jip6 zi1 hau6 jap6 zo2 gwong2 gou3 jip6 zou6

rows.note: Use this when referring to the advertising profession and the people or field associated with it rather than the industry as a business sector.

example.english: People in advertising circles are really into using artificial intelligence to make videos these days.
example.traditional: 廣告界最近好興用人工智能整片。
example.jyutping: gwong2 gou3 gaai3 zeoi3 gan6 hou2 hing1 jung6 jan4 gung1 zi3 nang4 zing2 pin3
